prompt: Same retrieved document, same question — with and without a citation instruction:

options.label: No citation requirement
options.content: "Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days." - confident, plausible, and reads exactly the same whether it came straight from the retrieved document or drifted from the model's own training-data instincts partway through. There's no way to tell which happened just by reading the answer.

options.label: "Cite which document supports each claim"
options.content: "Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days (Source: refund-policy.md, chunk 2)." Now the claim is checkable - open refund-policy.md, look at chunk 2, and confirm it actually says that. If the model's citation doesn't hold up, that's an immediate, visible signal something went wrong - a signal the uncited version never gave you.
